design_note: Training acquisition queue, not a representative evaluation sample. selection_fraction is selected/eligible, not an inverse-probability weight. inclusion_probability is known only for an uncapped first uniform random-control draw; capped and targeted rows have unknown inclusion probabilities. Do not use this mixed queue to estimate population prevalence or final performance.
notes: No label in this queue is filled in. Rule and model outputs are kept in annotation_queue_provenance.csv and must not be shown to annotators.
Completed batches are validated with `python -m src.ml.annotation_queue validate`; they are never merged into the labelled corpus automatically.

Built from the 304-row demo extract because the canonical signal set is absent. This pool is small and YouTube-heavy, so most strata cannot be filled; rebuild from data/processed/signals_scored.csv for the real batch.
